title: Rollout Owner & Blocker Lifecycle Map — Inference
content:
Purpose:
A compact, action-oriented tracker for customer inference rollouts that emphasizes: owner lanes, active blockers, mitigation owners, and next actionable steps. Designed to be used during weekly cadence calls and to feed the QBR renewal health metric (operational readiness).

Scope:
- Applies to Hosted / Dedicated / Private inference deployments that are in implementation phase (POC -> Production).
- Focus on customer-facing implementation milestones (ops, infra, model onboarding, perf tuning, cutover).

How to use this doc:
1) Owner updates their lane before the weekly sync (red/yellow/green + 1-line note).
2) CS lead drives blocker triage and assigns mitigation owner.
3) Capture Jira/Confluence refs so follow-ups are tracked.
4) After each sync, update "next action" and ETA.

Milestone lanes (compact rows):
- Commercial Close | Owner: Account Executive | ETA: 2025-01-21 | Status: Green | Blocker: N/A | Mitigation owner: N/A | Next action: Collect signed SOW and onboarding kickoff notes. | Ref: CS-289
- Network & Access (VPC, peering, firewall) | Owner: Solutions Eng - Diego A. | ETA: 2025-01-28 | Status: Yellow | Blocker: Customer infra team requested private IP ranges change; AP team needs approval | Mitigation owner: Customer infra lead (L. Patel) + SE to provide network plan | Next action: Diego to share IP plan by 2025-01-16; escalate to SRE if no response. | Ref: CONF-4567
- Image & Secrets Provisioning (KMS/HSM integration) | Owner: Platform Onboarding - Priya N. | ETA: 2025-02-04 | Status: Yellow | Blocker: KMS key policy requires audit review delaying HSM onboarding | Mitigation owner: Security (+Priya) to run one-hour review session | Next action: Schedule audit call 2025-01-18; provide sample policy template. | Ref: CS-312
- Model Artifacts & Version Pinning | Owner: Applied ML - Omar S. | ETA: 2025-02-10 | Status: Green | Blocker: Model conversion succeeded but one attention pattern mismatch observed | Mitigation owner: Applied ML -> Omar to run conversion debug; fallback to previous quantized variant | Next action: Omar to open a model debug ticket and share logs by 2025-01-17. | Ref: MLD-78
- Performance Tuning (latency SLOs, batching, KV cache) | Owner: Performance Eng - TBA | ETA: 2025-02-18 | Status: Red | Blocker: Sustained p95 > target during synthetic load due to batch queueing at sequence length 1024 | Mitigation owner: Serving runtime eng (Ben R.) + Customer devs | Next action: Run profiling snapshot 2025-01-19; try smaller max_batch and enable prefix cache. | Ref: PERF-2025-01
- Pre-cutover Validation (smoke tests, canary routing) | Owner: CS Implementation - Maya C. | ETA: 2025-02-22 | Status: Green | Blocker: N/A | Mitigation owner: N/A | Next action: Prepare canary traffic script and acceptance criteria. | Ref: CONF-4600
- Cutover & Monitoring (traffic shift, rollback plan) | Owner: Platform Ops - SRE | ETA: 2025-02-25 | Status: Green | Blocker: Monitoring dashboards not yet created for token-level cost breakdown | Mitigation owner: Observability team | Next action: SRE to open dashboard ticket and assign to observability by 2025-01-20. | Ref: OBS-77
- Post-cutover Acceptance & Handoff (SLA signoff + runbook) | Owner: Customer Success - Maya C. | ETA: 2025-03-01 | Status: Green | Blocker: Draft runbook needs customer review | Mitigation owner: CS + Solutions Eng | Next action: Send runbook draft to customer 2025-01-21. | Ref: CS-HO-01
- Renewal Trigger & Health Signal | Owner: Account Manager | ETA: 90 days before renewal | Status: Green | Blocker: N/A | Mitigation owner: N/A | Next action: Map usage to renewal guardrails; flag any perf regressions. | Ref: AM-142

Weekly Cadence / Meeting Guide:
- 30-minute weekly owner sync: 10m owner-updates, 10m blocker triage, 10m action assignment.
- Preflight (48h before major milestone): Ops checklist run by Platform Onboarding.
- Escalation path: SE -> CS Lead -> SRE -> CTO (if SLA at risk). List owners in header of calendar invite.

Blocker handling rules (short):
- Any blocker marked Red requires a mitigation owner and a written plan within 24h.
- Yellow blockers need an assignee and ETA for resolution within 72h.
- Green blockers are tracked but do not require immediate action.

Risk scoring (quick heuristic):
- Score = (Impact 1-5) x (Likelihood 1-5). High risk: >=12. Add to renewal health dashboard if high.

Definitions / field guidance:
- Status: Green/Yellow/Red (simple RAG).
- Owner: Person responsible to drive milestone to completion.
- Mitigation owner: Person responsible for resolving blocker (can be different).
- ETA: target completion date; update weekly.
- Ref: Primary ticket or doc to follow (Jira/Confluence/PR).

Open questions / notes to resolve:
- Decide on a single canonical Jira project for rollout tracking (CS vs ENG).
- Confirm whether customers require on-prem HSM or cloud KMS for this account.
- Agree channel for immediate escalations (Slack #cs-rollouts vs PagerDuty).

Appendix: Suggested checklist for 48h preflight:
- Confirm private networking test completed and verified by cloud provider.
- Verify model artifact CRCs and version pins match release manifest.
- Validate monitoring alerts (token-cost, latency p50/p95, error-rate) are firing in test channel.
- Ensure rollback image and traffic split policy are ready (50/50 -> 100/0).

Change log:
- 2025-01-14: Created initial lifecycle map (Maya C.).
- 2025-02-02: Added perf tuning row and preflight checklist; assigned mitigation owners (Diego, Priya, Omar).

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep rows deliberately short; long narratives go in linked Confluence page.
- This doc should be copied into customer-facing tracker with stripped internal notes before handing over for read-only distribution.
